title: Evaluation of the immunomodulatory effects of C9-13-CPs in macrophages.
authors: Xue, Zimeng; Zhu, Jianbo; Wang, Xia; Yang, Chunlei; Fu, Zhengwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究短链氯化石蜡对巨噬细胞的免疫调节效应，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-受体，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Short-chain chlorinated paraffins (SCCPs) have been listed as a new class of persistent organic pollutants by the Stockholm Convention. SCCPs exhibit carcinogenic-, endocrine-, and metabolism-disrupting effects. However, the knowledge of the immunomodulatory effects of SCCPs and their underlying mechanisms, especially in specific immune cells, remains limited. In addition to SCCPs, C9-13-CPs have also been detected in humans. In this study, murine RAW264.7 macrophages were exposed to C9-13-CPs at environmentally relevant concentrations to investigate whether or how C9-13-CPs exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The results showed that the exposure of RAW264.7 cells to C9-13-CPs increased cell viability, as assayed by MTT analysis at 490 nm, and also promoted cell proliferation, as indicated by EdU uptake assay, which was measured at excitation and emission wavelengths of 488 and 512 nm, respectively. In addition, exposure to C9-13-CPs not only led to elevated ATP level and intracellular Ca2+ level but also caused AMPK signaling activation and NF-kappaB signaling inhibition. Moreover, molecular docking showed that the beta2-AR receptor could bind to C9-13-CPs. Taken together, these results suggest that the immune dysfunction of RAW264.7 cells caused by C9-13-CPs is closely related to the beta2-AR/AMPK/NF-kappaB signaling axis.
abstract_zh: 短链氯化石蜡（SCCPs）已被《斯德哥尔摩公约》列为新型持久性有机污染物。SCCPs具有致癌、内分泌干扰和代谢紊乱效应。然而，关于SCCPs的免疫调节作用及其潜在机制，特别是在特定免疫细胞中的研究，仍十分有限。除SCCPs外，C9-13-CPs也已在人体中检测到。本研究将小鼠RAW264.7巨噬细胞暴露于环境相关浓度的C9-13-CPs，以探讨C9-13-CPs是否或如何发挥免疫调节作用。结果表明，通过MTT分析在490 nm波长下检测，C9-13-CPs暴露增加了RAW264.7细胞的活力；同时，通过EdU摄取实验（分别在488和512 nm的激发和发射波长下测量）显示，其促进了细胞增殖。此外，C9-13-CPs暴露不仅导致ATP水平和细胞内Ca2+水平升高，还引起AMPK信号通路激活和NF-kappaB信号通路抑制。进一步地，分子对接显示beta2-AR受体能与C9-13-CPs结合。综合来看，这些结果表明C9-13-CPs引起的RAW264.7细胞免疫功能障碍与beta2-AR/AMPK/NF-kappaB信号轴密切相关。
